description: Delete one customer organization (a B2B account your contacts belong to, shown under Subscribers > Organizations) and its memberships. Contacts are kept; their `organization.*` attributes are cleared. It never deletes the user's Sequenzy account, workspace (company), login or API keys. If the user asks to delete their own Sequenzy account or workspace, do not call this tool: that is only possible in the Sequenzy dashboard. Permanent; confirm the organization's externalId with the user first.

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

externalId.description: Customer-owned account (organization/workspace) ID, e.g. the org id in your app.

name: delete_account

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `delete_account` MCP tool.

deleted.description: True when the account was deleted.

items.description: Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

membersCleared.description: Number of memberships removed (contacts are kept).

message.description: Human-readable status, confirmation, or next-step message.

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.

warnings.description: Non-fatal cautions about content, permissions, or follow-up actions.
